messages:
ashley: Heads-up: scheduling a Key Custody tabletop for tomorrow 09:00 PT. Scope: BYOK handoffs, RBAC JIT issuance, and rewrap/fallback playbooks in staging only. Need oncall, ops, legal, and SRE to attend. No production HSM touches.

kevin: Sounds good. Are we doing a fake key import or replaying a customer-provided BYOK flow?

ashley: We'll replay a BYOK operator workflow but with synthetic key material in a staging HSM. Goal is to verify entitlement issuance, audit event richness, and emergency rewrap. Runbook (draft): https://internal.redwood/runbooks/key-custody-tabletop

maria: Audit asks: ensure operator identity (email), role tag, session id, and MFA flag are emitted in every KMS/HSM event. Retention in staging should match SOC2 acceptance for the drill (30d) and we must produce log checksums post-run.

ashley: Staging log retention is 90d by default. We'll tag events with fields: actor_email, actor_role, admin_session_id, mfa_present. We'll also compute a SHA256 digest of the log bundle after the drill.

tony: I can prepare the JIT RBAC role. What actions does it need? Want least privilege.

ashley: Create role: drill/broker_operator. Limit to staging key ARNs only. Allowed actions: kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:ReEncrypt, kms:Encrypt, kms:DescribeKey. Explicit deny for production ARNs and deny kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion. Condition: aws:SourceVpc == staging-vpc AND aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent == true. JIT duration = 45 minutes.

kevin: For logging queries, we'll add structured labels. Example extraction to look for suspicious rewraps:

```
resource.type="kms_key" AND jsonPayload.action:("ReEncrypt" "GenerateDataKey")
| parse jsonPayload.actor_email as actor
| sort timestamp desc
```

maria: On vuln triage: found vendor HSM firmware advisory (CVE-2026-1111) affecting an old staging image. Low remote risk but we should not upgrade mid-drill. We'll simulate an operator account compromise instead of exercising the vendor issue.

ashley: Agreed. Simulation will include mid-run revocation of the JIT role and an automated failover to the rewrap-only service account. Measuring detection-to-rewrap latency is the key metric.

sec-bot: :information_source: Runbook checklist missing: "notify-legal-and-compliance" and "archive-audit-digest" steps. Please update before execution.

oncall-night: I'll handle the handoff. Suggest we pre-create an emergency unseal token, store in Vault with 2-person approval, and log the unseal operations. I'll also shadow the operator during the drill.

tony: I'll push the role and a policy with explicit resource constraints to staging IAM. Will add a policy condition listing production ARNs in a deny block to be safe.

kevin: Post-drill extraction snippet for logs (gcloud):

```
PROJECT=redwood-staging
gcloud logging read 'resource.type=kms_key' --project="$PROJECT" --freshness=72h --format=json > /tmp/key-drill-logs.json
cat /tmp/key-drill-logs.json | jq -r '.[] | {ts: .timestamp, action: .jsonPayload.action, actor: .jsonPayload.actor_email, sess: .jsonPayload.admin_session_id}'
```

maria: After-action deliverables: timeline with precise timestamps, RBAC diff (before/after), log digest file, and a compliance memo for legal. Also include remediation steps if rewrap failed.

ashley: I'll update the runbook with: attendee list, legal notif step, exact IAM policies to apply, audit extraction commands, and postmortem template (timeline + RBAC delta + logs + detection-to-rewrap metric). Posting invite now and will tag reviewers. :white_check_mark: 

kevin: One more: set monitoring alerts to escalate if any rewrap attempt returns non-2xx. Fail closed and route traffic away from affected nodes.

ashley: Noted. Thanks all — see you tomorrow.
